_description: Comprehensive agronomic mapping linking plant diseases to specific fertilizer prescriptions, nutrient adjustments, and organic soil amendments for Indian agriculture. Based on ICAR, TNAU, PAU, and IARI extension guidelines.
_primary_sources: https://agritech.tnau.ac.in/ (Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Agritech Portal)
https://www.pau.edu/ (Punjab Agricultural University Package of Practices)
https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in/ (Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India)

fertilizer_recommendation.primary_soil_fertilizer: NPK 10:26:26 (Complex) or Muriate of Potash (MOP / SOP)
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Strictly reduce nitrogen by 25-30%. Avoid late spring urea top-dressing.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 20%. Apply Potassium Sulphate (SOP 0:0:50).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_phosphorus: Maintain basal Single Super Phosphate (SSP) for root vigor.
foliar_micronutrients: Calcium Chloride (CaCl₂) @ 0.5% (5 g/L) to strengthen cuticle and fruit epidermis
Zinc Sulphate (heptahydrate 21%) @ 0.5% (5 g/L) + unslaked lime (0.25%) pre-bloom
organic_bio_amendments: Urea foliar spray @ 5% immediately before leaf fall in autumn to accelerate decomposition of scab-bearing fallen leaves
Apply well-decomposed Farm Yard Manure (FYM) @ 25-30 kg per tree
Neem cake @ 2-3 kg per tree around the basin
fertilizers_to_avoid: Excess Urea / Ammonium Nitrate (causes excessive succulent vegetative growth highly susceptible to scab ascospores)
Over-irrigation combined with nitrogenous top-dressing

dosage_and_application.basal: NPK 10:26:26 @ 500 g per bearing tree in December-January during dormancy
dosage_and_application.foliar_spray: Calcium chloride @ 5 g/L applied 4 times from petal fall at 14-day intervals
dosage_and_application.autumn_sanitation: 5% Urea foliar spray onto foliage right before leaf drop to starve overwintering pseudothecia

Apple___Apple_scab.scientific_rationale: Excessive nitrogen softens cuticle and epidermal cell walls, facilitating penetration by Venturia inaequalis appressoria. Potassium and calcium enhance lignin deposition and cell wall pectin density, restricting fungal hyphal advancement.
Apple___Apple_scab.extension_reference: ICAR-CITH (Central Institute of Temperate Horticulture, Srinagar) & Dr YS Parmar UHF Solan Apple Advisory.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Moderate nitrogen. Apply only in split doses in early spring.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 15-20% to prevent stress-induced fruit decay.
foliar_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 0.5% (5 g/L) at fruit development stages
Boric acid @ 0.1% (1 g/L) during pink bud to enhance fruit firmness
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma harzianum @ 50 g/tree mixed in 10 kg FYM applied around tree canopy
Neem cake @ 2.5 kg/tree
fertilizers_to_avoid: Heavy late-season nitrogen (promotes tender shoot blights and canker susceptibility)

dosage_and_application.basal: MOP @ 400 g + SSP @ 700 g per mature tree
dosage_and_application.foliar_spray: Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L sprayed post-bloom to harden fruit skin against rotting

Apple___Black_rot.scientific_rationale: Adequate calcium prevents fruit softening and calyx-end leakage where Botryosphaeria rot enters. Potassium accelerates wound healing following pruning.
Apple___Black_rot.extension_reference: SKUAST-Kashmir & Dr YS Parmar UHF Apple Disease Management Schedule.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Keep nitrogen balanced to low. Never apply excess top-dressing during rust sporulation periods (spring).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Elevate potassium to strengthen leaf structure against rust haustoria.
foliar_micronutrients: Mono Potassium Phosphate (MKP 0:52:34) @ 0.5% (5 g/L) as resistance inducer
Zinc Sulphate @ 0.3% + Lime @ 0.15%
organic_bio_amendments: FYM enriched with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 50 g/tree
fertilizers_to_avoid: Fast-release urea during damp spring months

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 500 g per tree in late winter
dosage_and_application.foliar_spray: MKP (0:52:34) @ 5 g/L at early leaf emergence

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.scientific_rationale: High foliar phosphate and potassium (0:52:34) trigger systemic acquired resistance (SAR) against rust fungi and thicken cuticle layers.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Standard recommendation: 700 g Urea per mature tree (split into pre-bloom and post-fruit set).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Standard recommendation: 700 g MOP per mature tree.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_phosphorus: Standard recommendation: 1000 g SSP per mature tree.
foliar_micronutrients: Solubor (Boron 20%) @ 1 g/L at pink bud stage
Zinc Sulphate @ 5 g/L + hydrated lime @ 2.5 g/L after harvest
organic_bio_amendments: FYM @ 30-40 kg per mature tree annually during winter dormancy
fertilizers_to_avoid: Applying fertilizers directly against trunk

dosage_and_application.basal: Full FYM, full SSP, and 50% MOP in December; 50% N at green tip; remaining N and K after fruit set.

Apple___healthy.scientific_rationale: Maintains balanced vegetative and reproductive growth, annual bearing, and high fruit color and shelf-life.
Apple___healthy.extension_reference: TNAU Horticulture Dept & ICAR Package of Practices for Temperate Fruits.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Split nitrogen into 3 distinct doses; avoid heavy basal urea that causes dense canopy.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium dose by 25 kg/ha (MOP @ 40 kg/acre). Potassium reduces Cercospora lesion expansion.
foliar_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO₄ 21%) @ 10 kg/acre soil application or 0.5% foliar spray with lime
Foliar spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) at knee-high stage
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma viride @ 2.5 kg/ha mixed with 250 kg FYM applied basally
Deep ploughing with crop residue incorporation using decomposer
fertilizers_to_avoid: Single heavy dose of urea; unamended soils low in potassium

dosage_and_application.basal: 1/3rd N (Urea 35 kg/acre) + full P (DAP 50 kg/acre) + full K (MOP 30 kg/acre) + ZnSO₄ 10 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.top_dress: 1/3rd N at knee-high (30-35 DAS) and 1/3rd N at tasseling stage (55-60 DAS)

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.scientific_rationale: Potassium deficiency dramatically increases maize susceptibility to Cercospora by disrupting stomatal conductance and protein synthesis.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.extension_reference: ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR), Ludhiana & PAU Maize Advisory.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Do not over-apply nitrogen. Excess N prolongs susceptibility to urediniospores.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Top-dress with MOP @ 15 kg/acre at 30 days to build epidermal resistance.
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar spray of water-soluble 0:52:34 (MKP) @ 5 g/L to check rust pustule eruption
Zinc Sulphate @ 0.5% spray at 40 DAS
organic_bio_amendments: FYM @ 5 tonnes/acre at land preparation
Seed treatment with Azospirillum @ 200 g/acre
fertilizers_to_avoid: Top-dressing urea during continuous damp/foggy weather

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 50 kg/acre + MOP 25 kg/acre + Neem-Coated Urea 30 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.curative_foliar: Spray 0:52:34 @ 1 kg/acre in 200 L water at first appearance of rust pustules

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.scientific_rationale: High N:K ratio encourages intercellular spaces in mesophyll tissue where rust mycelium proliferates. High K hardens cell membranes.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.extension_reference: ICAR-IIMR & TNAU Agritech Portal — Millets/Maize Pathology.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Reduce nitrogen by 20% if infection appears before tasseling; apply strictly in splits.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 25%. Adequate K directly suppresses Exserohilum blight severity.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_phosphorus: Ensure full basal dose of SSP or DAP; phosphorus promotes root strength and rapid emergence.
foliar_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 5 g/L foliar spray at knee-high stage
Potassium Nitrate (Multi-K 13:0:45) @ 10 g/L spray to restore photosynthetic capacity
organic_bio_amendments: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 10 g/kg seed
Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre
fertilizers_to_avoid: Excessive nitrogenous top-dressing; broadcast application of unamended urea on moist foliage

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 45 kg/acre + MOP 30 kg/acre + Urea 25 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.top_dress: Urea 25 kg/acre at 30 DAS; foliar spray of 13:0:45 @ 1 kg/acre in 150 L water at 45 DAS

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.scientific_rationale: Turcicum blight forms extensive cigar-shaped lesions that destroy photosynthetic area. Potassium accelerates stomatal control and cell wall lignification, restricting lesion coalescence.

fertilizer_recommendation.primary_soil_fertilizer: Urea + DAP + MOP (State recommended dose: 120:60:40 kg/ha NPK)
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Standard full split: 1/3 basal, 1/3 knee-high (30 DAS), 1/3 tasseling (55 DAS).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Standard full basal dose.
foliar_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 10 kg/acre soil application (mandatory for Indian hybrid maize)
19:19:19 foliar spray @ 5 g/L at 40 DAS for hybrid vigour
organic_bio_amendments: FYM @ 4-5 tonnes/acre
Azotobacter / PSB seed treatment @ 250 g/acre each
fertilizers_to_avoid: Applying all nitrogen at once (causes leaching and volatilisation)

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 50 kg + MOP 30 kg + Urea 30 kg + ZnSO₄ 10 kg per acre
dosage_and_application.split_2: Urea 30 kg/acre at tasseling / silking stage

Corn_(maize)___healthy.scientific_rationale: Optimal vegetative development, maximum cob filling, and high protein content in grain.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.extension_reference: TNAU Agritech Portal & PAU Package of Practices for Maize.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Keep nitrogen balanced; do NOT starve plant of N as early blight preferentially attacks senescing older leaves under nitrogen deficiency.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 20%. Apply SOP (0:0:50) which improves tuber skin set and foliage immunity.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_phosphorus: Full basal dose via Single Super Phosphate (SSP provides 11% Sulphur).
foliar_micronutrients: Mancozeb-compatible foliar spray of Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 10 g/L
Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 2 g/L + Boron @ 1 g/L at tuber initiation
organic_bio_amendments: Neem cake @ 150 kg/acre at planting
Tuber treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/kg seed tuber
fertilizers_to_avoid: Imbalanced high-nitrogen without potash; using chloride-rich MOP in saline soils

dosage_and_application.basal: SSP 150 kg/acre + SOP 50 kg/acre + Urea 40 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.top_dress: Urea 35 kg/acre during earthing-up (30 DAS); foliar 13:0:45 @ 1 kg/acre at 45 and 60 DAS

Potato___Early_blight.scientific_rationale: Alternaria is a necrotrophic pathogen that flourishes on prematurely aging tissues. Balanced nitrogen prevents premature senescence, while potassium strengthens outer parenchymal walls.
Potato___Early_blight.extension_reference: ICAR-CPRI (Central Potato Research Institute, Shimla) Disease Advisory.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: CRITICAL: Immediately stop or reduce nitrogen by 30-40%. Never apply urea top-dressing during cloudy, humid blight weather.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Boost potassium by 25%. Potassium promotes phytoalexin production and cell wall lignification.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_phosphorus: Ensure robust phosphorus; phosphorus enhances phytohormone defense against oomycetes.
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar spray of Potassium Phosphite (or 0:52:34 MKP) @ 3-5 g/L (induces SAR against Phytophthora)
Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L to strengthen tuber periderm against blight rot
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma harzianum @ 2.5 kg/acre in 100 kg FYM at planting
Avoid fresh animal manure during active growing season
fertilizers_to_avoid: Urea / Ammonium Sulphate top-dressing (destroys crop within 48h by creating succulent watery leaf tissue)
Over-irrigation immediately following fertilization

dosage_and_application.basal: Full SSP 150 kg/acre + SOP 60 kg/acre + modest Urea 30 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.emergency_adjustment: If blight detected: HALT urea immediately. Spray MKP (0:52:34) @ 5 g/L tank-mixed with systemic fungicide (Cymoxanil/Metalaxyl-Mancozeb).

Potato___Late_blight.scientific_rationale: Excessive nitrogen elevates soluble amino acids and sugars in the apoplast, acting as a rapid food source for Phytophthora hyphae. High potassium enhances sub-epidermal thickness and suppresses sporangial germination.
Potato___Late_blight.extension_reference: ICAR-CPRI Shimla Late Blight Decision Support System.

fertilizer_recommendation.primary_soil_fertilizer: Urea + DAP / SSP + MOP / SOP (Standard Indian recommendation: 150:100:120 kg/ha NPK)
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Split: 50% basal + 50% at earthing-up (30-35 DAS).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Split: 50% basal + 50% at earthing-up (SOP preferred for high specific gravity chips).
foliar_micronutrients: 19:19:19 @ 5 g/L at 40 DAS for vegetative growth
0:0:50 (Potassium Sulphate) @ 10 g/L at 65-70 DAS for tuber bulking
organic_bio_amendments: FYM @ 10-12 tonnes/acre
Azotobacter & Phosphobacteria @ 1 kg/acre each
fertilizers_to_avoid: Applying excessive nitrogen after 45 days (delays tuberization and promotes hollow heart)

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 75 kg + MOP 50 kg + Urea 40 kg per acre
dosage_and_application.top_dress: Urea 40 kg + MOP 30 kg per acre during earthing-up

Potato___healthy.scientific_rationale: High K ensures starch translocation from leaves into tubers, high dry-matter content, and superior storage quality.
Potato___healthy.extension_reference: ICAR-CPRI & TNAU Agritech Portal — Potato Production Guidelines.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Reduce nitrogen by 25%. Avoid ammonium-based fertilizers (use nitrate forms).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Maintain high potassium levels to support cell wall pectin cross-linking.
foliar_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L foliar spray (calcium pectate protects intercellular spaces against bacterial pectolytic enzymes)
Copper Oxychloride (50% WP) @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L bactericidal spray
Borax @ 1 g/L to assist calcium translocation
organic_bio_amendments: Seedling dip in Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L for 30 minutes before transplanting
Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre in planting furrow
fertilizers_to_avoid: High urea top-dressing (creates thin, hydathode-leaking leaves where Xanthomonas enters)
Overhead sprinkler irrigation that splashes bacteria

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 75 kg/acre + FYM @ 5 tonnes/acre
dosage_and_application.foliar: Spray Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L every 10-12 days during flowering and fruit setting

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.scientific_rationale: Bacterial pathogens enter via stomata and hydathodes. High nitrogen increases hydathode guttation droplets loaded with nutrients that feed bacterial colonies. Calcium builds rigid calcium pectate in the middle lamella.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.extension_reference: ICAR-IIHR (Indian Institute of Horticultural Research, Bengaluru) Tomato Advisory.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Moderate nitrogen in frequent small fertigation splits. Do NOT allow plants to become nitrogen deficient, as Alternaria colonizes senescent lower foliage.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 20% (use SOP 0:0:50). Enhances leaf cuticle thickness.
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar spray of Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 5 g/L alternating with fungicide cover sprays
Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 2.5 g/L + Boron @ 1 g/L
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma harzianum @ 2 kg/acre mixed with 200 kg vermicompost applied at root zone
Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre
fertilizers_to_avoid: Sudden heavy urea bursts; allowing lower leaves to touch moist soil

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 50 kg + MOP 30 kg + Urea 25 kg per acre
dosage_and_application.fertigation_foliar: 13:0:45 @ 5 g/L foliar spray at 10-day intervals from first fruit setting

Tomato___Early_blight.scientific_rationale: Alternaria produces target-board necrotic lesions by secreting alternaric acid. Potassium enhances phenolic defense compound accumulation, restricting lesion size.
Tomato___Early_blight.extension_reference: ICAR-IIHR Bengaluru & TNAU Vegetable Crop Management.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: URGENT: Cease all urea/nitrogen application immediately upon symptom detection.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 25-30% using Potassium Sulphate or Potassium Phosphite.
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar spray of Potassium Phosphite (0:52:34 MKP) @ 4 g/L (triggers natural systemic acquired resistance)
Calcium Nitrate @ 4 g/L to protect green and ripening fruits from brown watery rot
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma viride root application @ 5 g/L drenching
Neem oil spray @ 3 mL/L as preventive barrier
fertilizers_to_avoid: Urea, Ammonium Sulphate, or high-N fertigation formulas (causes water-soaked lesions to spread through entire canopy within 24-48 hours)

dosage_and_application.basal: SSP 100 kg + SOP 40 kg + Neem Cake 100 kg per acre
dosage_and_application.curative_protocol: Stop nitrogen immediately. Spray MKP (0:52:34) @ 5 g/L along with protective fungicide (Mancozeb 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph 1 g/L).

Tomato___Late_blight.scientific_rationale: High tissue nitrogen directly stimulates zoosporangia germination and rapid intercellular colonization. High potassium thickens epidermis and stimulates PR (pathogenesis-related) protein synthesis.
Tomato___Late_blight.extension_reference: ICAR-IIHR Tomato Disease Advisory & TNAU Late Blight Management.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Moderate nitrogen. Avoid excess vegetative density that traps humidity in polyhouse or field.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 15% (MOP/SOP).
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar spray of 0:52:34 (MKP) @ 5 g/L (suppresses conidial sporulation on leaf underside)
Calcium Nitrate @ 3 g/L
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma harzianum foliar spray @ 5 g/L
Ensure ventilation and lower humidity in greenhouse/polyhouse
fertilizers_to_avoid: High nitrogen fertilizers that cause dense, unpruned leaf canopies

dosage_and_application.foliar: Spray 0:52:34 @ 5 g/L to lower surfaces of leaves every 12 days

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.scientific_rationale: Leaf mold enters via abaxial stomata under high relative humidity (>85%). Moderate canopy growth ensures rapid air drying and stomatal closure.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.extension_reference: ICAR-IARI (Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi) Protected Cultivation Division.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Keep nitrogen balanced; do not starve plants. Mulch soil surface to prevent rain-splash from soil-applied fertilizers.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Boost potassium by 15-20% (use SOP or MOP).
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45) @ 5 g/L combined with copper or mancozeb sprays
Zinc Sulphate @ 2 g/L
organic_bio_amendments: Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre + silver-black plastic mulch or straw mulch
Soil drenching with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L
fertilizers_to_avoid: Broadcast un-incorporated fertilizers; overhead watering onto fertilized beds

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 50 kg + MOP 30 kg + Urea 25 kg per acre

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.scientific_rationale: Septoria spores are splashed from soil onto lower leaves. Potassium hardens lower leaf cuticles, delaying spore establishment.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: CRITICAL: Drastically reduce nitrogen. High nitrogen causes high free amino acid levels in sap that trigger explosive spider mite reproduction.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 20%.
foliar_micronutrients: Potassium Silicate (Soluble Silica) @ 2.5 mL/L foliar spray (deposits silicon in leaf epidermal cells, wearing down mite mouthparts)
Magnesium Sulphate (Epsom salt) @ 3 g/L to restore chlorophyll destroyed by mite stylets
Elemental Sulphur (Wettable Sulphur 80% WDG) @ 3 g/L (serves as both acaricide and essential secondary nutrient Sulphur)
organic_bio_amendments: Neem oil (Azadirachtin 10000 ppm) @ 2 mL/L foliar spray
Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L bio-acaricide
fertilizers_to_avoid: Urea / Ammonium Nitrate top-dressing (proven to multiply mite fecundity and egg-laying rate by up to 300%)

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 60 kg/acre + Neem cake 150 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.curative_spray: Wettable Sulphur @ 3 g/L + Potassium Silicate @ 2 mL/L sprayed on underside of leaves

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.scientific_rationale: Spider mite stylets pierce epidermal cells. High foliar nitrogen makes sap rich in amino acids, accelerating mite reproduction. Silicon and potassium harden the cuticle, impeding stylet penetration.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.extension_reference: ICAR-National Bureau of Agricultural Insect Resources (NBAIR) & TNAU Acarology Advisory.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Moderate nitrogen. Avoid high vegetative shading.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 20% to fortify fruit and foliage against Corynespora pinprick lesions.
foliar_micronutrients: Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L to prevent circular target spot lesions on green fruit
0:52:34 (MKP) @ 5 g/L at 14-day intervals
organic_bio_amendments: Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L root zone drench
Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre
fertilizers_to_avoid: Excessive nitrogenous top-dressing; unpruned suckers creating moist microclimate

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 75 kg/acre + SSP 50 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.foliar: Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L + Boron @ 1 g/L every 12 days during fruit bulking

Tomato___Target_Spot.scientific_rationale: Calcium pectate in fruit pericarp prevents Corynespora hyphal penetration and fruit dropping.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Maintain moderate nitrogen in small frequent splits. High nitrogen attracts whitefly vectors due to bright green tender flush.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Increase potassium by 25% (use Potassium Nitrate 13:0:45). Potassium maintains vascular water tension in stunted virus-infected plants.
foliar_micronutrients: Chelated Zinc (Zn-EDTA 12%) @ 1.5 g/L + Ferrous Sulphate @ 2 g/L (corrects viral-induced severe chlorosis and cupping)
Foliar spray of 13:0:45 @ 5 g/L every 10 days to sustain flower retention
Solubor (Boron 20%) @ 1 g/L to prevent flower drop
organic_bio_amendments: Neem oil @ 3 mL/L + Yellow sticky traps (20 per acre) to control whitefly vector
Soil application of Vermicompost @ 1 tonne/acre enriched with Pseudomonas fluorescens
fertilizers_to_avoid: Fresh urea flushes that stimulate succulent shoot flushes which whiteflies prefer for egg laying

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 80 kg/acre + ZnSO₄ 10 kg/acre + Borax 5 kg/acre
dosage_and_application.foliar_booster: Zn-EDTA @ 1.5 g/L + 13:0:45 @ 5 g/L + Neem oil @ 3 mL/L sprayed weekly

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.scientific_rationale: While fertilizers cannot eradicate the virus from phloem, supplemental micronutrients (Zn, Fe, B) and potassium stimulate lateral branching, minimize vein chlorosis, and allow partial yield salvage.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.extension_reference: ICAR-IIHR & TNAU Vegetable Entomology/Virology Advisory for TYLCV.

fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Keep nitrogen moderate. Do not over-fertilize with nitrogen.
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Boost potassium by 20% to reduce internal fruit browning ('blotchy ripening').
foliar_micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 2 g/L + Magnesium Sulphate @ 3 g/L to combat mosaic mottling
Potassium Sulphate (0:0:50) foliar spray @ 5 g/L at fruit development
organic_bio_amendments: Seed treatment with Trisodium phosphate (10% TSP) solution for 30 minutes before sowing
Milk spray (skimmed milk powder @ 10%) on workers hands and seedlings during transplanting to neutralize ToMV particles
fertilizers_to_avoid: Excessive nitrogen (induces severe distortion, 'shoestring' leaves, and hollow fruits)

dosage_and_application.basal: 10:26:26 @ 75 kg/acre + FYM 5 tonnes/acre
dosage_and_application.foliar: Magnesium Sulphate @ 3 g/L + 13:0:45 @ 5 g/L every 15 days

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.scientific_rationale: Tobamovirus impairs chloroplast function and sugar transport. Magnesium re-synthesizes chlorophyll; potassium prevents internal fruit vascular necrosis.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.extension_reference: ICAR-IARI Plant Virology Division & PAU Vegetable Guidelines.

fertilizer_recommendation.primary_soil_fertilizer: Urea + DAP + MOP (State recommended dose: 120:80:100 kg/ha NPK)
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_nitrogen: Split: 50% basal + 25% at 30 days + 25% at 45 days (flowering).
fertilizer_recommendation.action_on_potassium: Split: 50% basal + 50% at fruit set (crucial for red lycopene pigment and firm skin).
foliar_micronutrients: Foliar 19:19:19 @ 5 g/L at vegetative stage
Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L + Boron @ 1 g/L at fruit setting (prevents blossom end rot)
13:0:45 @ 5 g/L during fruit harvesting flushes
organic_bio_amendments: FYM @ 10 tonnes/acre
Azospirillum & Phosphobacteria @ 1 kg/acre each
fertilizers_to_avoid: Excessive nitrogen during flowering (causes flower drop and bushy growth)

dosage_and_application.basal: DAP 50 kg + MOP 35 kg + Urea 30 kg per acre
dosage_and_application.top_dress_2: Urea 25 kg + MOP 30 kg/acre at fruit set (45 DAS)

Tomato___healthy.scientific_rationale: Balanced nutrition drives rapid canopy establishment, high fruit set, uniform fruit size, thick pericarp, and high Brix (sweetness/firmness).
Tomato___healthy.extension_reference: TNAU Agritech Portal & ICAR-IIHR Tomato Production Package.
